zones.what: Lifeboats are mounted at Deck 1; they obstruct ocean views from Decks 1, 2, and portions of Deck 6, with Deck 1 most affected and Deck 6 showing partial obstruction depending on cabin position.
zones.effect: Ocean view and balcony cabins look directly at or over orange lifeboat shells; the horizon remains visible but the view down to the water is blocked.
zones.mattersTo: Matters greatly to guests who want unobstructed water views or photo opportunities; irrelevant to interior cabin guests and those prioritizing price over view quality.

zones.what: Deck 9 forward and midship sits directly below the Lido Deck pool area, buffet, and outdoor activities on Deck 10.
zones.effect: Expect foot traffic noise, deck chair scraping, and activity sounds from above starting early morning through late evening.
zones.mattersTo: Light sleepers and those sensitive to overhead noise should avoid; won't bother guests out of the cabin most of the day.

zones.what: Deck 11 midship sits directly below the SportSquare and outdoor recreation area on Deck 12.
zones.effect: Noise from basketball, mini-golf, and ropes course activity overhead during the day.
zones.mattersTo: Problematic for daytime nappers or remote workers; Cloud 9 Spa guests here expect tranquility and may be disappointed.

zones.what: Deck 2 midship sits directly above main dining room and galley operations on Deck 1.
zones.effect: Possible galley noise, ventilation hum, and occasional clattering during meal prep hours, especially early morning and dinner service.
zones.mattersTo: Sensitive sleepers should note this; won't affect heavy sleepers or those dining when the galley is active anyway.

zones.what: Decks 7 and 8 aft sit above the main theater (Encore Showroom) which spans Decks 3-5 aft.
zones.effect: Theater is two to four decks below, so sound transmission is minimal, but late shows may produce faint vibration or bass.
zones.mattersTo: Only the most sensitive guests need consider this; distance provides good insulation.

zones.what: Primary elevator banks run forward and midship on all guest decks, with forward elevators serving the main atrium area.
zones.effect: Cabins adjacent to elevators gain convenience for mobility-limited guests but experience bell chimes, door sounds, and hallway congregation noise throughout the day and night.
zones.mattersTo: High-traffic hallways bother light sleepers; convenience is essential for those with mobility issues or young children with strollers.

zones.what: Decks 1 and 2 aft sit closest to engine room operations low in the hull.
zones.effect: Low-frequency vibration and hum are most noticeable here, particularly when engines throttle up during departure or maneuvering.
zones.mattersTo: Vibration-sensitive guests and those bothered by mechanical sounds should avoid; others may not notice or may find the hum soothing.

zones.what: Bow thruster operation occurs low and forward during docking and maneuvering in port.
zones.effect: Loud grinding or humming noise during port arrival and departure, typically early morning and evening for a few minutes at a time.
zones.mattersTo: Light sleepers in forward cabins on port days will be awakened; deep sleepers and early risers unaffected.

zones.what: Cloud 9 Spa cabins on Decks 11 and 12 include dedicated spa access and spa-themed amenities.
zones.effect: Premium pricing for spa proximity and amenities; these cabins cater to wellness-focused guests willing to pay extra for the spa experience.
zones.mattersTo: Only worthwhile for guests who will use the spa facilities extensively; unnecessary expense for others.

zones.what: Deck 2 features Cove Balcony cabins with balconies positioned lower and closer to the waterline than standard balconies.
zones.effect: Unique perspective closer to the water, but more wave spray potential in rough seas and less privacy as balconies are visible from public decks above.
zones.mattersTo: Appeals to those wanting a different view experience and typically lower pricing; rough-weather cruisers should note spray risk.
